_meta.description: Applied on top of furniture_recommendations.json's persona-selected pieces, keyed by room_type x size bucket (micro/tight/compact/standard/generous/large — same keys as room_constraints.json). exclude_roles drops a role entirely. dimension_overrides replaces ONLY the dimensions string of a matching role (type/shape stay persona-flavored). add_pieces appends new size-specific pieces not part of the base persona table. size_note is a one-line rationale shown next to the furniture table, tying back to room_constraints.json.
